info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Trade Banking Notional Poolings-spec
info.description: The Notional Pooling Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of trade banking notional poolings, enabling users to view and analyze pooling arrangements across different accounts. This API is essential for financial institutions looking to optimize cash management and liquidity while facilitating inter-company financing solutions. Typical consumers include treasury departments and financial analysts who require insights into notional pooling arrangements for strategic decision-making. Through this endpoint, users can efficiently retrieve detailed information on available pooling options and their respective terms.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding notional pooling services in trade banking. Notional pooling is a financing arrangement where multiple accounts are aggregated for interest calculations, improving cash management efficiency.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving notional pooling operations in trade banking. This request body contains parameters necessary for the API to process the request and return the relevant notional pooling information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested data.
